pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! .expect(\"raw endpoints array\");\n        assert_eq!(typed.data.endpoints.len(), raw_eps.len());\n\n        fn str_or_num_to_f64(v: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<f64> {\n            match v {\n                serde_json::Value::Number(n) => n.as_f64().or_else(|| {\n                    if n.as_u64().unwrap_or_default() == 0 {\n                        Some(0.0)\n                    } else {\n                        panic!(\"Invalid State: not f64 AND u64\")\n                    }\n                }),\n                serde_json::Value::String(s) => s.parse::<f64>().ok(),\n                _ => None,\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}")

pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! crate::parser::nodes::{GeneratesAnyNodeId as _, ModuleNodeId};\n    use ploke_core::{CrateId, ItemKind};\n    use std::path::PathBuf;\n    use uuid::Uuid;\n\n    fn test_state() -> VisitorState {\n        let namespace = Uuid::new_v4();\n        let root = PathBuf::from(\"/tmp/typed-type-graph-test\");\n        let context = CrateContext {\n            id: CrateId::from_root_path(&root),\n            name: \"typed_type_graph_test\".into(),\n            version: \"0.0.0\".into(),\n            namespace,\n            root_path: root.clone(),\n            files: vec![root.join(\"src/lib.rs\")],\n            targets: Vec::new(),\n            features: Features::default(),\n            dependencies: Dependencies::default(),\n            dev_dependencies: DevDependencies::default(),\n            workspace_path: None,\n        };\n        let mut state = VisitorState::new(namespace, root.join(\"src/lib.rs\"), &context);\n        let module_any = state.generate_synthetic_node_id(\"crate\", ItemKind::Module, None);\n        let module_id: ModuleNodeId = module_any.try_into().expect(\"module id\");\n        state.current_primary_defn_scope.push(module_id.into());\n        state\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn constructs_typed_named_type_with_typed_argument() {\n        let mut state = test_state();\n        let ty: Type = syn::parse_str(\"Vec<Result<String, Error>>\").expect(\"type syntax\");\n\n        let root_id = get_or_create_type(&mut state, &ty);\n        let root = state\n            .code_graph\n            .type_graph\n            .iter()\n            .find(|node| node.id() == root_id.into())\n            .expect(\"root type node\");\n\n        let TypedTypeNode::Named(named) = root else {\n            panic!(\"expected named root type\");\n        };\n        assert_eq!(named.path, vec![\"Vec\"]);\n        assert_eq!(named.arguments.len(), 1);\n        assert_eq!(state.code_graph.type_graph.len(), 4);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn constructs_reference_node_with_typed_child_id() {\n        let mut state = test_state();\n        let ty: Type = syn::parse_str(\"&'a mut Foo\").expect(\"type syntax\");\n\n        let root_id = get_or_create_type(&mut state, &ty);\n        let root = state\n            .code_graph\n            .type_graph\n            .iter()\n            .find(|node| node.id() == root_id.into())\n            .expect(\"root type node\");\n\n        let TypedTypeNode::Reference(reference) = root else {\n            panic!(\"expected reference root type\");\n        };\n        assert_eq!(reference.lifetime.as_deref(), Some(\"a\"));\n        assert!(reference.is_mutable);\n        assert!(matches!(reference.referenced, OrdinaryTypeUseId::Named(_)));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn trait_object_stores_narrow_children_and_widens_for_traversal() {\n        let mut state = test_state();\n        let ty: Type = syn::parse_str(\"dyn Iterator<Item = Vec<Foo>> + Send\").expect(\"type syntax\");\n\n        // This example has three different syntactic positions:\n        //\n        // - `dyn Iterator<Item = Vec<Foo>> + Send` is the whole type expression.\n        //   Syn parses it as `Type::TraitObject`, so it is an ordinary type use\n        //   at the parser-node slot boundary.\n        //\n        // - `Iterator<Item = Vec<Foo>>` and `Send` are bounds inside that trait\n        //   object. Syn parses them as `TypeParamBound::Trait`, so they inhabit\n        //   the trait-position family.\n        //\n        // - `Vec<Foo>` is the associated type value for `Iterator::Item`. Syn\n        //   parses that value as ordinary `Type::Path` syntax, so it inhabits\n        //   the ordinary type-use family even though it is nested under a trait\n        //   bound.\n        let root_id = get_or_create_type(&mut state, &ty);\n        let root = state\n            .code_graph\n            .type_graph\n            .iter()\n            .find(|node| node.id() == root_id.into())\n            .expect(\"root type node\");\n\n        let TypedTypeNode::TraitObject(trait_object) = root else {\n            panic!(\"expected trait object root type\");\n        };\n        assert_eq!(trait_object.bounds.len(), 2);\n\n        // The trait object stores the two bounds in the narrow trait-position\n        // family. These are not ordinary type-use roots, even though the\n        // containing `dyn ...` expression is an ordinary type use.\n        assert!(\n            trait_object\n                .bounds\n                .iter()\n                .all(|bound| matches!(bound, TraitTypeSourceId::TraitBound(_)))\n        );\n\n        // Find the `Iterator<Item = Vec<Foo>>` bound so we can inspect the\n        // nested associated type value. This checks the distinction between\n        // the trait-position bound itself and the ordinary type syntax inside\n        // its generic/associated arguments.\n        let iterator_bound =\n            trait_object\n                .bounds\n                .iter()\n                .copied()\n                .find_map(|bound| match bound {\n                    TraitTypeSourceId::TraitBound(id) => state\n                        .code_graph\n                        .type_graph\n                        .iter()\n                        .find_map(|node| match node {\n                            TypedTypeNode::TraitBound(node)\n                                if node.id == id && node.path == [\"Iterator\"] =>\n                            {\n                                Some(node)\n                            }\n                            _ => None,\n                        }),\n                    _ => None,\n                })\n                .expect(\"Iterator trait bound node\");\n\n        assert_eq!(iterator_bound.arguments.len(), 1);\n\n        // `Vec<Foo>` is stored as `OrdinaryTypeUseId::Named(_)`, not as a trait\n        // use. The fact that it appears inside `Iterator<...>` does not make\n        // it a trait-position bound; the syntactic position of the argument\n        // controls the family.\n        assert!(matches!(\n            iterator_bound.arguments[0],\n            OrdinaryTypeUseId::Named(_)\n        ));\n\n        // Traversal is the first point where these narrow child families are\n        // widened into `AnyTypeId`. For the root trait-object node, that means\n        // its two stored `TraitTypeSourceId` bounds project to\n        // `AnyTypeId::TraitBound(_)` children.\n        let widened_children: Vec<_> = root.child_type_ids().collect();\n        assert!(\n            widened_children\n                .iter()\n                .all(|child| matches!(child, AnyTypeId::TraitBound(_)))\n        );\n    }\n}")

pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! pre-allocate to avoid reallocations\n        let node_types = NodeType::primary_and_assoc_nodes();\n        let mut all_results: Vec<(Uuid, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(node_types.len() * top_k);\n\n        for node_type in node_types {\n            let params = self.cfg.params_for(node_type);\n            let max_hits = params.max_hits.max(top_k);\n            let args = SimilarArgs {\n                db: &self.db,\n                vector_query: &query_embedding,\n                scope,\n                k: top_k * 8,\n                ef: params.ef, // Configurable ef value\n                ty: node_type,\n                max_hits,\n                // radius: params.radius, // Configurable radius value\n                radius: 100.0, // Configurable radius value\n            };\n\n            let result = search_similar_args(args)?;\n\n            // Convert distance to similarity score (lower distance = higher similarity)\n            all_results.extend(\n                result\n                    .typed_data\n                    .v\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .zip(result.dist.into_iter())\n                    .map(|(embed_data, distance)| (embed_data.id, 1.0 - distance as f32)),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Sort by score (highest first) and take top_k\n        all_results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n        all_results.truncate(top_k);\n\n        Ok(all_results)\n    }\n", namespace: 087fac4e-61bb-51c9-913c-64c1aebd30e5 }], files: ["/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs"], edits_ns: [], preview: CodeBlocks { per_file: [BeforeAfter { file_path: "crates/ploke-rag/src/core/mod.rs", before: "#![allow(missing_docs)]\n//! fn default() -> Self {\n        Self {\n            enabled: cfg!(feature = \"typed_type_graph\"),\n            max_seed_hits: 12,\n            max_expanded_hits: 48,\n            score_factor: 0.6,\n type_context: TypeContextConfig::default(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl RagConfig {\n    pub fn params_for(&self, ty: NodeType) -> SearchParams {\n        self.search_per_type.get(&ty).copied().unwrap_or_default()\n    }\n}\n\n/// Optional async reranker for candidate reordering using snippet texts.\n#[allow(clippy::type_complexity)]\npub trait Ok(candidates.into_iter().map(|(id, _)| (id, 1.0)).collect()) })\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(feature = \"typed_type_graph\")]\nfn type_context_kind(relation: TypeContextRelation) -> TypeContextKind {\n 137269:      "content": "{\"ok\":true,\"file_path\":\"/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/lib.rs\",\"exists\":true,\"byte_len\":7321,\"start_line\":null,\"end_line\":null,\"truncated\":false,\"content\":\"#![allow(unused_variables, unused_imports, dead_code)]\\n//! ploke-rag — Retrieval and context assembly for the PLOKE workspace\\n//!\\n//! This crate provides the \\\"R\\\" and \\\"A\\\" of RAG for the PLOKE workspace:\\n//! - Retrieval: sparse (BM25) via an in-memory actor and dense (HNSW) via `ploke-db`.\\n//! - Fusion: score normalization, weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), optional Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR).\\n//! - Context assembly: selecting, trimming, ordering and packaging snippets under a token budget.\\n//!\\n//! The design emphasizes deterministic behavior, strong observability, and strict error handling,\\n//! while integrating with the rest of the PLOKE system (database, IO manager, and embedding backends).\\n//!\\n//! Highlights\\n//! - Async BM25 client wrapper with timeouts, retries/backoff, and strict vs. lenient modes.\\n//! - Dense retrieval across all primary node types using [`ploke_db`]'s HNSW helpers.\\n//! - Pluggable fusion (RRF + MMR) and score normalization utilities.\\n//! - Context assembly with budgeting, deduplication, and stable ordering.\\n//! - Structured tracing for operability (suitable for tests and metrics-ready).\\n//!\\n//! Concurrency and actors\\n//! - BM25 is served by an actor (Tokio task) in `ploke-db` receiving `Bm25Cmd` over `mpsc` and\\n//!   replying via `oneshot` channels. All calls from this crate are enforced with client-side timeouts.\\n//! - Dense retrieval executes against `ploke-db` HNSW via synchronous calls wrapped in async fns.\\n//! - Snippet IO is delegated to `ploke-io`'s actor (if configured) and is used by reranking and\\n//!   by the context assembler.\\n//!\\n//! Error handling\\n//! - Channel send/recv failures map to [`RagError::Channel`].\\n//! - Database/actor errors map to [`RagError::Db`] while preserving inner messages.\\n//! - Embedding pipeline failures map to [`RagError::Embed`].\\n//! - Search state violations (e.g., strict BM25 while uninitialized) map to [`RagError::Search`].\\n//! - A conversion into the workspace error type is provided (`impl From<RagError> for ploke_error::Error`).\\n//!\\n//! Observability\\n//! - The BM25 client wrapper emits fields such as: `bm25_status`, `strict`, `attempts`,\\n//!   `timeout_ms`, `fallback_used`, `bm25_results`, and `dense_results`.\\n//! - Tests can opt-in to tracing; non-test binaries get a minimal, target-less fmt layer by default.\\n//!\\n//! Configuration\\n//! - See [`RagConfig`] to control BM25 timeouts/backoff/strict default, fusion settings,\\n//!   per-type dense search parameters, context assembly policy, tokenizer, and (optional) reranker.\\n//!\\n//! Quickstart\\n//! ```no_run\\n//! use std::sync::Arc;\\n//! use ploke_core::RetrievalScope;\\n//! use ploke_rag::{RagService, RetrievalStrategy, TokenBudget};\\n//! use ploke_embed::runtime::EmbeddingRuntime;\\n//! use ploke_db::{Database};\\n//!\\n//! # async fn doc_example(mut db: Arc<Database>, embedder: Arc<EmbeddingRuntime>) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {\\n//! // Construct the service (BM25 actor is started internally).\\n//! let rag = RagService::new(db.clone(), embedder.clone())?;\\n//!\\n//! // Sparse-only (lenient): falls back to dense if BM25 is unready/empty.\\n//! let bm25_hits = rag.search_bm25(\\\"how to implement graph nodes\\\", 15, RetrievalScope::LoadedWorkspace).await?;\\n//!\\n//! // Hybrid: concurrent BM25 + dense, fused via weighted RRF.\\n//! let fused = rag.hybrid_search(\\\"module visibility rules\\\", 15, RetrievalScope::LoadedWorkspace).await?;\\n//!\\n//! // Assemble a context for downstream prompting.\\n//! let budget = TokenBudget { max_total: 1024, per_file_max: 512, per_part_max: 256 };\\n//! let ctx = rag.get_context(\\n//!     \\\"module visibility rules\\\",\\n//!     12,\\n//!     &budget,\\n//!     &RetrievalStrategy::Hybrid { rrf: Default::default(), mmr: None },\\n//!     RetrievalScope::LoadedWorkspace,\\n//! ).await?;\\n//! # Ok(()) }\\n//! ```\\n//!\\n//! BM25 lifecycle and persistence\\n//! - This crate re-exports [`Bm25Status`] and provides thin call-throughs for `save` and `load`.\\n//!   Current persistence is a lightweight sidecar (version + doc_count) and `load` triggers a rebuild\\n//!   from the DB in `ploke-db`. Keep API usage stable to benefit from future serialization improvements.\\n//!\\n//! Algorithms\\n//! - RRF: [`rrf_fuse`] implements weighted reciprocal rank fusion with stable UUID tie-breaking.\\n//! - Score normalization: [`normalize_scores`] provides min-max, z-score, and logistic transforms.\\n//! - MMR: [`mmr_select`] performs diversity-aware selection using cosine similarity on normalized vectors.\\n//!\\n//! Threading and performance\\n//! - `RagService` holds `Arc`s to the database handle and embedding processor, and an `mpsc` sender to BM25.\\n//!   Clone or share it behind `Arc` in your application services.\\n//! - BM25 RPCs are local and fast; a client-side timeout guards unexpected stalls (default 250ms) with\\n//!   up to two status/backoff retries in lenient mode.\\n//!\\n//! Stability and versioning\\n//! - Public APIs follow SemVer. The default behavior of existing methods is preserved; strict and persistence\\n//!   features are opt-in. See `crates/ploke-rag/IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md` and `plans.md` for cross-crate design.\\n//!\\n//! Re-exports\\n//! - [`Bm25Status`], [`RrfConfig`], [`MmrConfig`], [`Similarity`], [`ScoreNorm`],\\n//!   [`normalize_scores`], [`rrf_fuse`], [`mmr_select`], and context assembly types.\\n//!\\n//! Tips\\n//! - In tests, initialize tracing with your preferred subscriber; the library avoids double-registration.\\n//! - Provide a custom [`TokenCounter`] to align budgeting with your downstream LLM tokenizer.\\n//!\\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\\nuse std::sync::Arc;\\n// use tracing_subscriber::{prelude::__tracing_subscriber_SubscriberExt, util::SubscriberInitExt};\\n\\n#[cfg(not(test))]\\nstatic TRACER_INIT: std::sync::Once = std::sync::Once::new();\\n\\n#[cfg(test)]\\nstatic _TRACE_MARKER: () = ();\\n\\n// #[cfg(not(test))]\\n// fn ensure_tracer_initialized() {\\n//     TRACER_INIT.call_once(|| {\\n//         let fmt_layer = tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer().with_target(false);\\n//         let _ = tracing_subscriber::registry().with(fmt_layer).try_init();\\n//     });\\n// }\\n\\n#[cfg(test)]\\nfn ensure_tracer_initialized() {\\n    // Tests configure tracing themselves; no-op to avoid interfering with test harness.\\n}\\n\\nuse ploke_core::{\\n    EmbeddingData, RetrievalScope,\\n    rag_types::{TypeContextInfo, TypeContextKind},\\n};\\nuse ploke_db::{\\n    Database, DbError, NodeType, SimilarArgs, TypeContextOptions, TypeContextRelation,\\n    TypeContextSeed, TypedEmbedData,\\n    bm25_index::bm25_service::{self, Bm25Cmd},\\n    search_similar_args,\\n};\\nuse ploke_embed::indexer::{EmbeddingProcessor, IndexerTask};\\nuse thiserror::Error;\\nuse tokio::sync::{mpsc, oneshot};\\nuse tokio::time::{Duration, sleep, timeout};\\nuse tracing::{debug, instrument};\\nuse uuid::Uuid;\\n\\npub mod error;\\npub mod fusion;\\npub use error::RagError;\\npub use fusion::{\\n    MmrConfig, RrfConfig, ScoreNorm, Similarity, mmr_select, normalize_scores, rrf_fuse,\\n};\\npub mod context;\\npub use context::{\\n    ApproxCharTokenizer, AssemblyPolicy, Ordering, TokenBudget, TokenCounter, assemble_context,\\n    assemble_context_with_type_context,\\n};\\npub mod core;\\npub use core::{\\n    NoopReranker, RagConfig, RagService, Reranker, RetrievalStrategy, TypeContextConfig,\\n};\\npub use ploke_db::bm25_index::bm25_service::Bm25Status;\\n\\nconst BM25_TIMEOUT_MS: u64 = 250;\\nconst BM25_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS: [u64; 2] = [50, 100];\\n\",\"file_hash\":[81,78,198,14,143,70,69,183,206,169,253,144,252,12,57,236,173,45,53,115,49,250,210,85,65,99,169,152,98,195,120,86]}",

[`RagService`] is the primary entry point for performing sparse, dense, and hybrid retrieval,\\n//! as well as assembling a token-budgeted context. It wraps the BM25 actor with timeouts, optional\\n//! retries/backoff (lenient mode), and exposes strict variants and persistence hooks.\\n//!\\n//! Configure behavior via [`RagConfig`], including fusion defaults, dense search parameters, and\\n//! context assembly policy. For diversity or learning-to-rank experiments, plug in a custom [`Reranker`].\\nmod unit_tests;\\nuse super::*;\\nuse ploke_core::rag_types::AssembledContext;\\nuse ploke_embed::indexer::EmbeddingProcessor;\\nuse ploke_embed::runtime::EmbeddingRuntime;\\nuse ploke_io::IoManagerHandle;\\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\\n#[cfg(feature = \\\"typed_type_graph\\\")]\\nuse std::collections::HashSet;\\nuse std::future::Future;\\nuse std::pin::Pin;\\nuse std::sync::Arc;\\nuse tracing::trace;\\n\\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]\\npub enum RetrievalStrategy {\\n    Dense,\\n    Sparse {\\n        strict: Option<bool>,\\n    },\\n    Hybrid {\\n        rrf: RrfConfig,\\n        mmr: Option<MmrConfig>,\\n    },\\n}\\nimpl Default for RetrievalStrategy {\\n    fn default() -> Self {\\n        Self::Hybrid {\\n            rrf: RrfConfig::default(),\\n            mmr: None,\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]\\npub struct SearchParams {\\n    pub ef: usize,\\n    pub radius: f64,\\n    pub max_hits: usize,\\n}\\n\\nimpl Default for SearchParams {\\n    fn default() -> Self {\\n        Self {\\n            ef: 10,\\n            radius: 10.0,\\n            max_hits: 0,\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\\npub struct RagConfig {\\n    pub bm25_timeout_ms: u64,\\n    pub bm25_retry_backoff_ms: Vec<u64>,\\n    pub strict_bm25_by_default: bool,\\n    pub rrf_default: RrfConfig,\\n    pub mmr_default: Option<MmrConfig>,\\n    pub score_norm: ScoreNorm,\\n    pub search_per_type: HashMap<NodeType, SearchParams>,\\n    pub assembly_policy: AssemblyPolicy,\\n    pub token_counter: Arc<dyn TokenCounter>,\\n    pub reranker: Option<Arc<dyn Reranker>>,\\n    pub type_context: TypeContextConfig,\\n}\\n\\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]\\npub struct TypeContextConfig {\\n    pub enabled: bool,\\n    pub max_seed_hits: usize,\\n    pub max_expanded_hits: usize,\\n    pub score_factor: f32,\\n    pub options: TypeContextOptions,\\n}\\n\\nimpl Default for TypeContextConfig {\\n    fn default() -> Self {\\n        Self {\\n            enabled: cfg!(feature = \\\"typed_type_graph\\\"),\\n            max_seed_hits: 12,\\n            max_expanded_hits: 48,\\n            score_factor: 0.6,\\n            options: TypeContextOptions {\\n                max_distance: 4,\\n                ..TypeContextOptions::default()\\n            },\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nimpl Default for RagConfig {\\n    fn default() -> Self {\\n        Self {\\n            bm25_timeout_ms: crate::BM25_TIMEOUT_MS,\\n            bm25_retry_backoff_ms: crate::BM25_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS.to_vec(),\\n            strict_bm25_by_default: false,\\n            rrf_default: RrfConfig::default(),\\n            mmr_default: None,\\n            score_norm: ScoreNorm::default(),\\n            search_per_type: HashMap::new(),\\n            assembly_policy: AssemblyPolicy::default(),\\n            token_counter: Arc::new(crate::context::ApproxCharTokenizer),\\n            reranker: None,\\n            type_context: TypeContextConfig::default(),\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nimpl RagConfig {\\n    pub fn params_for(&self, ty: NodeType) -> SearchParams {\\n        self.search_per_type.get(&ty).copied().unwrap_or_default()\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n/// Optional async reranker for candidate reordering using snippet texts.\\n#[allow(clippy::type_complexity)]\\npub trait Reranker: Send + Sync + std::fmt::Debug {\\n    fn rerank<'a>(\\n        &'a self,\\n        query: &'a str,\\n        candidates: Vec<(Uuid, String)>,\\n    ) -> Pin<Box<dyn Future<Output = Result<Vec<(Uuid, f32)>, RagError>> + Send + 'a>>;\\n}\\n\\n#[derive(Debug, Default)]\\npub struct NoopReranker;\\n\\nimpl Reranker for NoopReranker {\\n    fn rerank<'a>(\\n        &'a self,\\n        _query: &'a str,\\n        candidates: Vec<(Uuid, String)>,\\n    ) -> Pin<Box<dyn Future<Output = Result<Vec<(Uuid, f32)>, RagError>> + Send + 'a>> {\\n        Box::pin(async move { Ok(candidates.into_iter().map(|(id, _)| (id, 1.0)).collect()) })\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n#[cfg(feature = \\\"typed_type_graph\\\")]\\nfn type_context_kind(relation: TypeContextRelation) -> TypeContextKind {\\n    match relation {\\n        TypeContextRelation::SameResolvedType => TypeContextKind::SameResolvedType,\\n        TypeContextRelation::UsesTypeNested => TypeContextKind::UsesTypeNested,\\n        TypeContextRelation::TypeDefinitionImpact => TypeContextKind::TypeDefinitionImpact,\\n        TypeContextRelation::ImplOfTrait => TypeContextKind::ImplOfTrait,\\n        TypeContextRelation::ImplSelfType => TypeContextKind::ImplSelfType,\\n        TypeContextRelation::AliasExpansion => TypeContextKind::AliasExpansion,\\n        TypeContextRelation::TraitBound => TypeContextKind::TraitBound,\\n        TypeContextRelation::IteratorSurface => TypeContextKind::IteratorSurface,\\n        TypeContextRelation::ConstGenericAlias => TypeContextKind::ConstGenericAlias,\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n/// RAG orchestration service.\\n///\\n/// This orchestrates hybrid search by combining:\\n/// - BM25 sparse search served by an in-memory actor\\n/// - Dense vector search served by the HNSW index in the database\\n///\\n/// Notes:\\n/// - BM25 search will gracefully fall back to dense search if the BM25 index is empty,\\n///   ensuring callers do not receive empty results due to indexing lag.\\n/// - Use `hybrid_search` to fuse the results via RRF for robust retrieval.\\n///\\n/// See crate tests for end-to-end examples using a fixture database.\\n#[derive(Debug)]\\npub struct RagService {\\n    db: Arc<Database>,\\n    dense_embedder: Arc<EmbeddingRuntime>,\\n    bm_embedder: mpsc::Sender<Bm25Cmd>,\\n    cfg: RagConfig,\\n    io: Option<Arc<IoManagerHandle>>,\\n    type_context_degraded: bool,\\n}\\n\\nimpl RagService {\\n    fn assemble(\\n        db: Arc<Database>,\\n        dense_embedder: Arc<EmbeddingRuntime>,\\n        bm_embedder: mpsc::Sender<Bm25Cmd>,\\n        mut cfg: RagConfig,\\n        io: Option<Arc<IoManagerHandle>>,\\n    ) -> Result<Self, RagError> {\\n        let type_context_degraded = Self::apply_type_context_gate(&db, &mut cfg)?;\\n        Ok(Self {\\n            db,\\n            dense_embedder,\\n            bm_embedder,\\n            cfg,\\n            io,\\n            type_context_degraded,\\n        })... visibility as the original struct (assumed `pub` within the crate).\n/// - A name derived by appending \"Info\" to the original struct name (e.g., `StructNode` -> `StructNodeInfo`).\n/// - A `pub id: ploke_core::NodeId` field.\n/// - All other public fields from the original struct, preserving their names and types.\n/// - Basic derives on the `*NodeInfo` struct: `Debug`, `Clone`, `PartialEq`.\n/// - A `pub(crate) fn new(info: *NodeInfo) -> Self` constructor method implemented on the original struct.\n///\n/// # Example Usage\n/// ```ignore\n/// // removed GenerateNodeInfo\n/// use ploke_core::{StructNodeId}; // Assuming these exist\n/// // ... other necessary imports ...\n///\n/// #[derive(GenerateNodeInfo)]\n/// pub struct StructNode {\n///     pub id: StructNodeId, // Typed ID in the original struct\n///     pub name: String,\n///     pub span: (usize, usize),\n///     // ... other fields\n/// }\n///\n/// // This will generate:\n/// // #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]\n/// // pub(crate) struct StructNodeInfo {\n/// //     pub id: ploke_core::NodeId, // Raw NodeId\n/// //     pub name: String,\n/// //     pub span: (usize, usize),\n/// //     // ... other fields copied from StructNode\n/// // }\n/// ```\n#[proc_macro_derive(GenerateNodeInfo)]\npub fn generate_node_info_derive(input: TokenStream) -> TokenStream {\n    // Parse the input tokens into a syntax tree (DeriveInput represents a struct/enum/union)\n    let input = parse_macro_input!(input as DeriveInput);\n\n    // Extract the name of the struct the derive is attached to (e.g., \"StructNode\")\n    let original_struct_name = &input.ident;\n\n    // Create the name for the generated *NodeInfo struct (e.g., \"StructNodeInfo\")\n    let info_struct_name = format_ident!(\"{}Info\", original_struct_name);\n\n    // Ensure the input is a struct\n    let fields = match &input.data {\n        Data::Struct(data_struct) => match &data_struct.fields {\n            Fields::Named(fields_named) => &fields_named.named,\n            _ => panic!(\"GenerateNodeInfo can only be derived on structs with named fields\"),\n        },\n        _ => panic!(\"GenerateNodeInfo can only be derived on structs\"),\n    };\n\n    // --- Generate the fields for the *NodeInfo struct ---\n    // We iterate through the fields of the original struct and copy them,\n    // except for the 'id' field, which we replace.\n\n    let mut info_fields = Vec::new();\n    // Add the mandatory 'id: NodeId' field first.\n    // IMPORTANT: Adjust the path `ploke_core::NodeId` if NodeId is located elsewhere\n    // relative to the crate where the *Node structs are defined (syn_parser).\n    info_fields.push(quote! {\n        /// The raw NodeId before being wrapped into a typed ID.\n        pub id: ::ploke_core::NodeId\n    });\n\n    // Iterate over the fields of the original struct\n    for field in fields {\n        let field_name = field\n            .ident\n            .as_ref()\n            .expect(\"Named fields should have names\");\n        let field_type = &field.ty;\n        let field_vis = &field.vis; // Capture original visibility\n\n        // Skip the original 'id' field, as we've already added our own 'id: NodeId'\n        if field_name == \"id\" {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Add the field to our list for the generated struct, preserving visibility\n        info_fields.push(quote! {\n            #field_vis #field_name : #field_type\n        });\n    }\n\n    // --- Generate the fields for the `new` method constructor body ---\n    let mut constructor_fields = Vec::new();\n    let mut id_type: Option<&Type> = None; // To store the type of the original 'id' field\n\n    for field in fields {\n        let field_name = field\n            .ident\n            .as_ref()\n            .expect(\"Named fields should have names\");\n        let field_type = &field.ty;\n\n        if field_name == \"id\" {\n            // Store the type of the original 'id' field (e.g., StructNodeId)\n            id_type = Some(field_type);\n            // Generate the ID wrapping line for the constructor using the restricted ::create method\n            constructor_fields.push(quote! {\n                #field_name : #field_type::create(info.id) // Use the restricted constructor\n            });\n        } else {\n            // Generate simple field copying for other fields\n            // Generate simple field copying for other fields\n            constructor_fields.push(quote! {\n                #field_name : info.#field_name\n            });\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Ensure the original struct had an 'id' field\n    let _ = id_type.expect(\"GenerateNodeInfo requires the struct to have an 'id' field.\");\n\n    // --- Generate the *NodeInfo struct definition ---\n    let generated_info_struct = quote! {\n        // Apply standard derives. Add more if needed (e.g., Serialize, Deserialize)\n        // but keep them minimal for these intermediate structs unless necessary.\n        #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]\n        // Make the generated struct pub(crate)\n        pub(crate) struct #info_struct_name {\n            // Add the collected fields, separated by commas\n            #(#info_fields),*\n        }\n    };\n\n    // --- Generate the `impl` block with the `new` constructor ---\n    let generated_impl = quote! {\n        impl #original_struct_name {\n            /// Creates a new instance from the corresponding `*NodeInfo` struct.\n            /// This constructor is typically `pub(crate)` and handles wrapping the raw `NodeId`\n            /// from the info struct into the specific typed ID for this node.\n            #[inline] // Suggest inlining for simple constructors\n            pub(crate) fn new(info: #info_struct_name) -> Self {\n                Self {\n                    // Add the generated constructor field assignments\n                    #(#constructor_fields),*\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n    // --- Combine generated struct and impl block ---\n    let final_output = quote! {\n        #generated_info_struct\n        #generated_impl\n    };\n\n    // Convert the combined tokens back into a TokenStream and return it\n    TokenStream::from(final_output)\n}")

138363:      "content": "{\"ok\":true,\"file_path\":\"/home/brasides/.ploke-eval/campaigns/p1-gated-parent-3g1x3-p3-20260630-174316/prototype1/workspaces/edit-harness/node-ec383aa38762a3d4-r3/crates/ploke-rag/src/lib.rs\",\"exists\":true,\"byte_len\":7321,\"start_line\":null,\"end_line\":null,\"truncated\":false,\"content\":\"#![allow(unused_variables, unused_imports, dead_code)]\\n//! ploke-rag — Retrieval and context assembly for the PLOKE workspace\\n//!\\n//! This crate provides the \\\"R\\\" and \\\"A\\\" of RAG for the PLOKE workspace:\\n//! - Retrieval: sparse (BM25) via an in-memory actor and dense (HNSW) via `ploke-db`.\\n//! - Fusion: score normalization, weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), optional Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR).\\n//! - Context assembly: selecting, trimming, ordering and packaging snippets under a token budget.\\n//!\\n//! The design emphasizes deterministic behavior, strong observability, and strict error handling,\\n//! while integrating with the rest of the PLOKE system (database, IO manager, and embedding backends).\\n//!\\n//! Highlights\\n//! - Async BM25 client wrapper with timeouts, retries/backoff, and strict vs. lenient modes.\\n//! - Dense retrieval across all primary node types using [`ploke_db`]'s HNSW helpers.\\n//! - Pluggable fusion (RRF + MMR) and score normalization utilities.\\n//! - Context assembly with budgeting, deduplication, and stable ordering.\\n//! - Structured tracing for operability (suitable for tests and metrics-ready).\\n//!\\n//! Concurrency and actors\\n//! - BM25 is served by an actor (Tokio task) in `ploke-db` receiving `Bm25Cmd` over `mpsc` and\\n//!   replying via `oneshot` channels. All calls from this crate are enforced with client-side timeouts.\\n//! - Dense retrieval executes against `ploke-db` HNSW via synchronous calls wrapped in async fns.\\n//! - Snippet IO is delegated to `ploke-io`'s actor (if configured) and is used by reranking and\\n//!   by the context assembler.\\n//!\\n//! Error handling\\n//! - Channel send/recv failures map to [`RagError::Channel`].\\n//! - Database/actor errors map to [`RagError::Db`] while preserving inner messages.\\n//! - Embedding pipeline failures map to [`RagError::Embed`].\\n//! - Search state violations (e.g., strict BM25 while uninitialized) map to [`RagError::Search`].\\n//! - A conversion into the workspace error type is provided (`impl From<RagError> for ploke_error::Error`).\\n//!\\n//! Observability\\n//! - The BM25 client wrapper emits fields such as: `bm25_status`, `strict`, `attempts`,\\n//!   `timeout_ms`, `fallback_used`, `bm25_results`, and `dense_results`.\\n//! - Tests can opt-in to tracing; non-test binaries get a minimal, target-less fmt layer by default.\\n//!\\n//! Configuration\\n//! - See [`RagConfig`] to control BM25 timeouts/backoff/strict default, fusion settings,\\n//!   per-type dense search parameters, context assembly policy, tokenizer, and (optional) reranker.\\n//!\\n//! Quickstart\\n//! ```no_run\\n//! use std::sync::Arc;\\n//! use ploke_core::RetrievalScope;\\n//! use ploke_rag::{RagService, RetrievalStrategy, TokenBudget};\\n//! use ploke_embed::runtime::EmbeddingRuntime;\\n//! use ploke_db::{Database};\\n//!\\n//! # async fn doc_example(mut db: Arc<Database>, embedder: Arc<EmbeddingRuntime>) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {\\n//! // Construct the service (BM25 actor is started internally).\\n//! let rag = RagService::new(db.clone(), embedder.clone())?;\\n//!\\n//! // Sparse-only (lenient): falls back to dense if BM25 is unready/empty.\\n//! let bm25_hits = rag.search_bm25(\\\"how to implement graph nodes\\\", 15, RetrievalScope::LoadedWorkspace).await?;\\n//!\\n//! // Hybrid: concurrent BM25 + dense, fused via weighted RRF.\\n//! let fused = rag.hybrid_search(\\\"module visibility rules\\\", 15, RetrievalScope::LoadedWorkspace).await?;\\n//!\\n//! // Assemble a context for downstream prompting.\\n//! let budget = TokenBudget { max_total: 1024, per_file_max: 512, per_part_max: 256 };\\n//! let ctx = rag.get_context(\\n//!     \\\"module visibility rules\\\",\\n//!     12,\\n//!     &budget,\\n//!     &RetrievalStrategy::Hybrid { rrf: Default::default(), mmr: None },\\n//!     RetrievalScope::LoadedWorkspace,\\n//! ).await?;\\n//! # Ok(()) }\\n//! ```\\n//!\\n//! BM25 lifecycle and persistence\\n//! - This crate re-exports [`Bm25Status`] and provides thin call-throughs for `save` and `load`.\\n//!   Current persistence is a lightweight sidecar (version + doc_count) and `load` triggers a rebuild\\n//!   from the DB in `ploke-db`. Keep API usage stable to benefit from future serialization improvements.\\n//!\\n//! Algorithms\\n//! - RRF: [`rrf_fuse`] implements weighted reciprocal rank fusion with stable UUID tie-breaking.\\n//! - Score normalization: [`normalize_scores`] provides min-max, z-score, and logistic transforms.\\n//! - MMR: [`mmr_select`] performs diversity-aware selection using cosine similarity on normalized vectors.\\n//!\\n//! Threading and performance\\n//! - `RagService` holds `Arc`s to the database handle and embedding processor, and an `mpsc` sender to BM25.\\n//!   Clone or share it behind `Arc` in your application services.\\n//! - BM25 RPCs are local and fast; a client-side timeout guards unexpected stalls (default 250ms) with\\n//!   up to two status/backoff retries in lenient mode.\\n//!\\n//! Stability and versioning\\n//! - Public APIs follow SemVer. The default behavior of existing methods is preserved; strict and persistence\\n//!   features are opt-in. See `crates/ploke-rag/IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md` and `plans.md` for cross-crate design.\\n//!\\n//! It wraps the BM25 actor with timeouts, optional\\n//! retries/backoff (lenient mode), and exposes strict variants and persistence hooks.\\n//!\\n//! Configure behavior via [`RagConfig`], including fusion defaults, dense search parameters, and\\n//! context assembly policy. For diversity or learning-to-rank experiments, plug in a custom [`Reranker`].\\nmod unit_tests;\\nuse super::*;\\nuse ploke_core::rag_types::AssembledContext;\\nuse ploke_embed::indexer::EmbeddingProcessor;\\nuse ploke_embed::runtime::EmbeddingRuntime;\\nuse ploke_io::IoManagerHandle;\\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\\n#[cfg(feature = RetrievalStrategy {\\n    Dense,\\n    Sparse {\\n        strict: Option<bool>,\\n    },\\n    Hybrid {\\n        rrf: RrfConfig,\\n        mmr: Option<MmrConfig>,\\n    },\\n}\\nimpl Default for RetrievalStrategy {\\n    fn default() -> Self {\\n        Self::Hybrid {\\n            rrf: RrfConfig::default(),\\n            mmr: None,\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]\\npub struct SearchParams {\\n    pub ef: usize,\\n    pub radius: f64,\\n    pub max_hits: usize,\\n}\\n\\nimpl Default for SearchParams {\\n    fn default() -> Self {\\n        Self {\\n            ef: 10,\\n            radius: 10.0,\\n            max_hits: 0,\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\\npub struct RagConfig {\\n    pub bm25_timeout_ms: u64,\\n    pub bm25_retry_backoff_ms: Vec<u64>,\\n    pub strict_bm25_by_default: bool,\\n    pub rrf_default: RrfConfig,\\n    pub mmr_default: Option<MmrConfig>,\\n    pub score_norm: ScoreNorm,\\n    pub search_per_type: HashMap<NodeType, SearchParams>,\\n    pub assembly_policy: AssemblyPolicy,\\n    pub token_counter: Arc<dyn TokenCounter>,\\n    pub reranker: Option<Arc<dyn Reranker>>,\\n    pub type_context: TypeContextConfig,\\n}\\n\\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]\\npub struct TypeContextConfig {\\n    pub enabled: bool,\\n    pub max_seed_hits: usize,\\n    pub max_expanded_hits: usize,\\n \\\"typed_type_graph\\\"),\\n            max_seed_hits: 12,\\n            max_expanded_hits: 48,\\n            score_factor: 0.6,\\n            options: TypeContextOptions {\\n                max_distance: 4,\\n                ..TypeContextOptions::default()\\n            },\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nimpl Default for RagConfig {\\n    fn default() -> Self {\\n        Self {\\n            bm25_timeout_ms: crate::BM25_TIMEOUT_MS,\\n            bm25_retry_backoff_ms: crate::BM25_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS.to_vec(),\\n            strict_bm25_by_default: false,\\n            rrf_default: RrfConfig::default(),\\n            mmr_default: None,\\n            score_norm: ScoreNorm::default(),\\n            search_per_type: HashMap::new(),\\n            assembly_policy: AssemblyPolicy::default(),\\n            token_counter: Arc::new(crate::context::ApproxCharTokenizer),\\n            reranker: None,\\n            type_context: TypeContextConfig::default(),\\n NoopReranker;\\n\\nimpl Reranker for NoopReranker {\\n    fn rerank<'a>(\\n        &'a self,\\n        _query: &'a str,\\n        candidates: Vec<(Uuid, String)>,\\n    ) -> Pin<Box<dyn Future<Output Option<Arc<IoManagerHandle>>,\\n    ) -> Result<Self, RagError> {\\n        let type_context_degraded = Self::apply_type_context_gate(&db, &mut cfg)?;\\n        Ok(Self {\\n            db,\\n            dense_embedder,\\n            bm_embedder,\\n            cfg,\\n            io,\\n            type_context_degraded,\\n        })...
